query:
-- Nebraska Senate + House
SELECT 'NE Senate' as race, state, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate1_vote_pct,
       candidate2_name, candidate2_party, candidate2_vote_pct,
       pct_reporting, primary_winner, primary_party, status
FROM senate_races WHERE state_code = 'NE'
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('NE-', district) as race, state_code, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate1_vote_pct,
       candidate2_name, candidate2_party, candidate2_vote_pct,
       pct_reporting, primary_winner, primary_party, status
FROM house_races WHERE state_code = 'NE' ORDER BY race;
